definitions.explanation: Preparing one's own meals at home rather than eating out or buying ready-made food.

examples.japanese: {自炊|じすい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{自炊|じすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: I started cooking for myself after I began living alone.

notes:
{自炊|じすい} means cooking for oneself at home, as opposed to eating out or buying ready-made food. Especially associated with students and people living alone.

WRITING:
{自|じ} (self) + {炊|すい} (cook rice). Literally "cooking (rice) for oneself."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自炊|じすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cook for oneself
- {自炊|じすい}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: life of cooking for oneself
- {自炊|じすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める: to start cooking for oneself
- {自炊|じすい}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧: someone who prefers cooking at home

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外食|がいしょく}→外食：03024_gaishoku⟧: eating out at restaurants
- ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧: convenience store bento
- ⟦{中食|なかしょく}→中食：22601_nakashoku⟧: buying prepared food to eat at home

CULTURAL NOTE:
{自炊|じすい} is a common topic when discussing ⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧ (living alone). University students often start {自炊|じすい} for the first time when they move away from home.
